lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Compras (receipt, refund, exchange, discount, bargain, out of stock, fitting room), substantivos formados de verbos (pay, payment).

aula.text: **Substantivos formados de verbos:** pay (pagar), payment (pagamento) · deliver (entregar), delivery (entrega) · decide (decidir), decision (decisão) · refund (reembolso) e offer (oferta) são iguais nos dois usos.
**fit x suit:** *fit* é o tamanho servir. *suit* é combinar, ficar bem.

items: "I bought this jacket in promotion." O certo é **on sale** (ou **on offer**).
"This colour doesn't fit me." O certo é **doesn't suit me.**

exercises.prompt: If you want your money back, you ask for a ___.
The shirt was 50% off. It was a real ___.
This shop doesn't have my size. It's ___ of stock.
I bought this jacket in promotion.
acc: I bought this jacket on sale
This colour does not suit me

lessons.title: Reported speech
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Reported speech: afirmações, perguntas, pedidos; said x told; mudanças de tempo verbal e de expressões de tempo.

head: Fala direta
Fala indireta
rows: He said he would call me.

aula.text: O verbo "anda um passo para trás": presente vira passado, present perfect vira past perfect, will vira would, can vira could.
**Perguntas:** ordem de frase afirmativa, sem do / does / did. *"Where do you live?"* vira *She asked me where I lived.* Pergunta de sim ou não usa **if**: *He asked if I liked it.*
**Pedidos e ordens:** *"Please wait."* vira *She asked me to wait.* *"Don't touch it!"* vira *He told me not to touch it.*
**Palavras de tempo:** today vira that day · tomorrow vira the next day · yesterday vira the day before · now vira then · here vira there.
**said x told:** *said* não leva pessoa (He said he was busy). *told* leva pessoa (He told me he was busy).

items: "He said me that he was tired." O certo é **He told me** ou **He said that.**
"She asked me where did I live." O certo é **where I lived.**

exercises.prompt: "I'm very busy," she said. → She said she ___ very busy.
"I'll call you tomorrow," he said. → He said he ___ call me the next day.
"Where do you work?" he asked me. → He asked me where I ___.
"Don't be late!" she told us. → She told us ___ late.
He said me that he was tired.
acc: He told me that he was tired

exercises.prompt: She asked me where did I live.
acc: She asked me where I lived

lessons.title: Inglês prático, trocar, devolver e negociar
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Trocar, devolver e negociar.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: I'd like to return this. / Can I exchange this for a different size? / It doesn't fit. / It's faulty.
Can I get a refund? / I have the receipt.
Is there any discount? / Is that your best price? / If I buy two, will you give me a discount?
I'm afraid we can't. / I can give you 10% off. / We only do exchanges.
I'll take it. / I'll think about it.

items: "This phone comes with defect." O certo é **It's faulty** ou **It has a fault.**
"Can I change by another colour?" O certo é **Can I exchange it for another colour?**
